title: A less expensive way to move out
label: Moving guides
description: Work through the dates, transport and rental terms that change your storage move-out cost.
body:
Compare the moving methods

Rental truck or several car trips? Work through a $95 truck quote, $48 in car trips and a $145 renewal.

Check your notice

When does your rental actually end? Prepare the questions to ask before your final trip.

Calculate the cost of waiting

Is another month worth it? Find how much a later move needs to save.

Use the calculator

title: Rental truck or several car trips?
label: Worked example
description: The cheaper moving method depends on whether you can finish before the next storage charge.
body:
Suppose your next full storage charge is $145 on December 1. Four car trips cost $12 each. An available truck costs $95 including mileage, fuel, tax and any chosen coverage. You have confirmed that no additional notice charge applies.

PlanTransportExtra rentTotal
Car trips finished November 30$48$0$48
Truck finished November 28$95$0$95
Car trips finished December 5$48$145$193

The fourth trip matters

When all four trips fit before renewal, using your car saves $47. If the last trip crosses into another full billing period, the truck saves $98. Count loading time, the return journey, access hours and the availability of someone to help with heavy items before choosing a finish date.

Use complete quotes

Add all trip costs once. For the truck, include its rental period, mileage, fuel, tax, coverage and any helper. For the car, include every return journey, parking and tolls. Put disposal and mandatory exit charges in the separate exit-cost field.

These prices are illustrative inputs. They are not current local quotes. The example assumes full-month renewal charges and no move-out refund.

Compare your dates and costs

title: Check the notice before your last trip
label: Move-out checklist
description: Your unit can be empty while your rental still has steps left to complete.
body:
Ask your facility for the final rental date and amount in writing before booking transport. Published operator instructions differ. Your agreement and the facility's confirmation provide the inputs for your comparison.

Ask these five questions

  • How many days of notice do I need, and how must I give it?
  • Has my notice been accepted, and what is my confirmed rental end date?
  • What will I owe if I leave on the renewal date or one day after it?
  • Will any prepaid rent or deposit be returned, and when?
  • Do I need an inspection, photographs or written closure confirmation?

Two published examples

Public Storage's move-out page asks customers to let it know at least seven days before moving out. Extra Space's FAQ lists at least 15 days of written notice or 10 days of verbal notice. These examples show why the calculator asks you to enter a notice period.

How the planner uses notice

If notice is given November 25 and you enter seven days, the estimate treats December 2 as the earliest release. Moving everything out on November 28 still leaves the entered notice period running. The full-month estimate counts a December 1 renewal in that situation. Confirm whether your facility actually bills this way.

If the facility confirms a different final amount, use the additional-rent override for that moving option. The planner does not interpret a lease or decide whether a disputed charge is enforceable.

Operator pages reviewed November 25, 2026. Public Storage move-out instructions. Extra Space move-out FAQ.

Compare using your terms

title: What does one more month need to save?
label: Worked example
description: A later moving date makes financial sense when its transport savings exceed the additional rent and fees.
body:
Compare complete exits. A plan to wait still needs the moving cost you eventually pay. Leaving that out makes waiting appear cheaper than it is.

A simple threshold

Moving this week costs $220 and avoids another rental charge. Moving later costs $80 for transport, plus $145 in additional rent. The later option totals $225, so moving now saves $5.

For waiting to cost less in this example, the eventual transport cost must fall below $75. That is the $220 cost today minus the $145 extra rental charge. Any extra exit charges reduce that $75 allowance further.

Waiting can cross more than one bill

With a $145 renewal on December 1 and January 1, finishing January 5 adds $290 under a full-month billing assumption. A $48 transport plan then costs $338. Check the notice end date as well as the day you can move.

Include the practical constraints

A cheap plan is only useful if you can complete it. Confirm transport availability, access hours, help, the destination for your belongings and any inspection appointment. Treat the cost comparison as one input to that decision.

These are worked examples with assumed full monthly charges. Use confirmed additional rent when your rental terms prorate or refund charges.

Compare moving now and later

title: How the comparison is calculated
label: Method
description: Every result comes from your dates and costs. Here are the assumptions that can change the answer.
body:
Additional cost through a completed exit

For each option, total cost equals moving cost plus additional rent plus other exit charges. Each option ends when the move and the entered notice period are complete. Money already paid and common to all options is excluded.

Rental renewals

The default estimate counts a full monthly charge for each renewal on or before the later of the moving date and notice end date. The next unpaid renewal must be today or within the next year. Moving dates can be up to two years ahead.

A monthly anniversary on the 31st is clamped to the last valid day in a shorter month, then returns to the original anniversary day when possible. If your facility uses a different billing calendar, obtain a final amount and use the override.

Notice

Notice end equals your entered notice date plus your entered number of calendar days. The planner assumes charges can continue until that date. It does not determine whether notice was accepted or whether a fee is enforceable.

Overrides and omissions

A nonnegative facility-confirmed additional-rent amount replaces the default rent estimate for one option. It can include refunds that reduce additional rent to zero. Refund credits larger than additional rent, deposits, disputed balances, future rate changes and currency conversion need a separate calculation. The planner assumes all entered transport plans are feasible.

Precision and privacy

Costs are rounded to US cents and added as integer cents. Dates use calendar days without daylight-saving adjustments. Inputs are processed in your browser. Changing an input hides the previous result until you calculate again.

Use the planner

title: About Clear Unit Plan
label: About & contact
description: A free calculator for deciding how and when to empty a storage unit.
body:
Clear Unit Plan compares the costs of car trips, a rental truck and a later move. It uses your quotes and rental terms to show how a deadline can change the cheaper option.

The project is operated by Mahmud Elgoueri from Libya for an English-speaking audience comparing US-dollar costs. The planner is independent of storage operators and moving companies. Worked examples use illustrative prices.

Report a problem

Open an issue in the project repository to report a calculation problem or suggest an improvement. GitHub issues are public. Use made-up amounts and dates and leave out your name, address, account details and rental agreement.

Editorial approach

Calculations use explicit inputs and a published method. Operator statements link to their sources and carry a review date. Changes to calculations are checked against fixed examples before publication.

Read the calculation method.

title: Privacy and your calculator inputs
label: Privacy
description: Your dates and costs are calculated in your browser. This version has no advertising or analytics scripts.
body:
Last updated November 25, 2026.

Calculator entries

The calculator processes your entries locally in your browser. This version does not send those entries to the site operator, put them in the page URL or save them to local storage. Reloading the page clears them.

Website requests

Your hosting provider receives normal requests to load the site, including technical information such as IP address and browser details. The stylesheet requests fonts from Google Fonts, which also receives the requests needed to deliver those fonts. Follow your hosting provider's and Google's privacy information for those services.

Advertising and analytics

This release includes no advertising or visitor analytics scripts. Any future addition of AdSense or analytics requires an updated notice and applicable consent configuration before activation.

Contact and public reports

Project reports use GitHub issues, a separate public service. Do not post personal or account information there. The operator is Mahmud Elgoueri, based in Libya.
